problem_type: No/low water supply, need for water tanker or septage service
department: Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation -- Smart Trivandrum civic services portal
description: Thiruvananthapuram's Smart Trivandrum civic services portal publishes a real, 24x7 Water/Septage help desk number. The portal cites an aggregate '92% within SLA' complaint-resolution statistic but does not publish the underlying numeric day/hour SLA itself. A 2-hour delivery window is stated for water tanker/septage service bookings specifically (a service-delivery commitment, not a complaint-resolution SLA).
procedure: Call the Water/Septage Help Desk (24x7) to report an issue or book a tanker/septage service.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for water-supply complaint resolution -- only an aggregate '92% within SLA' statistic is published, not the underlying day/hour figure. Water tanker/septage bookings specifically are delivered within 2 hours (a service-delivery window, not a complaint SLA).
